blocks.text: Take your outfit from day to night in the most effortless way with this forest green midi dress. Tying at the waist with a belt, it offers a flattering and classic silhouette you’ll feel comfortable in. We’ve designed it with button fastenings running down the front of the dress, as well as contrast stitch detailing on the seams. You’ll also find a collar at the neck and elasticated cuffs on the sleeves. This dress is all about the detail, so choose your accessories carefully in browns and neutrals for the complete look.
